description:
validate_script in crates/sieve-native/src/lib.rs recurses into nested blocks and test_lists without any depth counter or limit. A malicious operator-uploaded Sieve script with deeply nested if/else or allof/anyof constructs will exhaust the thread stack during compilation, crashing the SMTP process.

Trigger: compile a Sieve script with hundreds of nested if blocks or deeply nested allof/anyof test lists via the sieve_admin HTTP endpoint.

Fix: add a depth counter parameter to the recursive validation helpers and return a ParseError when the depth exceeds a safe limit (e.g. 32 or 64 levels), matching what production Sieve implementations (Dovecot Pigeonhole) impose.
title: sieve-native: validate_script unbounded recursion → stack overflow
